summary: Final evidence-grounded supervisor acceptance of the integrated A1-C2 curriculum, per supervisor-evidence-contract.md sec10. Re-verified both release-gate preconditions directly against current files rather than trusting prior completion-marker prose: the evidence gate is READY (120 pedagogical / 127 psychology unique primary studies, both re-measured on this branch's head), and every one of LC-AUD-001's cross-level-audit findings (F1-F11, F4b) was independently re-checked against the current docs/curriculum/blueprints/*.json -- all resolved except the one item LC-AUD-001 itself asked to leave to explicit human judgment (C2's sustain_coherence_across_topic_shifts prerequisite), which is openly flagged via an unresolvedPrerequisiteNote in c2.json rather than silently broken. Reviewed six cross-cutting design claims shared by the runtime engine across all six levels (evidence-tiered mastery/recognition-vs-production, delayed-retrieval capstones, corrective feedback with retry, the personalization invariant, non-manipulative motivation design, older-adult scaffolding) against the two primary-study corpora using the contract's required PASS/PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS/BLOCK/RESEARCH_NEEDED verdict format with cited evidence IDs, grades and populations -- including one RESEARCH_NEEDED (older-adult L2-pedagogy-specific evidence is a real, honestly-logged zero-coverage gap in the pedagogical corpus, matching LC-SUP-001's own already-logged limitation) rather than defaulting to approval. Spot-checked actual shipped runtime code (not just blueprint text) across A2/B1/B2/C1/C2 sample episodes plus the shared scaffolding.js/responseEvaluation.js/learnerModel.js engine, confirming the recognition/guided/independent distinction, retry/repair paths and delayed-retrieval evidence are real load-bearing code paths, and specifically verified that C2's multi-capability delayed-retrieval core-engine requirement (blueprints/c2.json coreEngineRequirements[3], which the blueprint itself still describes as an engine gap) is genuinely implemented end-to-end via learnerModel.js's recordDelayedRetrievalEvidence(model, canDoIds) and is live-wired from EpisodeShell.jsx, not dead code -- logging this as a non-blocking documentation-sync finding since c2.json was never annotated as resolved the way b2.json/c1.json's parallel F8 entries were. Confirmed A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2 all remain available:false, Pre-A1 remains frozen at 17 episodes, and no blueprint overclaims CEFR listening/speaking/pronunciation coverage the product cannot back. Overall verdict: PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS, recorded in docs/curriculum/final-supervisor-acceptance.md and .json with per-level verdicts (A1/A2/B2 PASS; B1/C1/C2 PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS on narrow, named, non-blocking gaps). This report does not open any level, does not flip any available flag, and does not certify real-learner efficacy -- A1's own separate completion gate and any later human-pilot validation remain untouched and still required.
